_about: Where the search synonym file (synonyms.jsonl) takes its names from. tier decides the ranking bonus (ranking.json 'synonym_tier_bonus'): 'registry' = an official registry name of that CAS, 'synonym' = a listed synonym / trade or industry label. KISCHEM is 'synonym' tier: its rows sometimes carry the parent substance's name on a related CAS (사이클로헥산 on cyclohexene 110-83-8, 활성탄 on 16291-96-6, Warfarin on its enantiomers). Built by scripts/search_synonyms/build_synonyms.py; terminology.db is read-only.
